correctness.rationale: Every pure profile is a functional digraph. Multiple cycles allow an improving cross-component redirection. Any tail depth at least two yields a legal parity-correct redirect that strictly lengthens the unique cycle. For one cycle with only depth-one leaves, every legal alternative gives a cycle no longer than the current one. The exact labeled count follows from choosing alternating cycle vertices, directed alternating cycles, and one-step leaf targets. The balanced asymptotic follows uniformly from Stirling bounds and the strictly concave exponent with unique omega-constant maximizer. Exact-rational finite cases independently exercise every profile for K_{a,b} at eight small parameter pairs (71,799 total), including all unilateral moves; this corroborates, rather than substitutes for, the all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: The initiating paper gives the buck-passing model, full-support ordinal potential, and the general two-mechanism characterization of profitable moves; these are cited, not claimed new. A direct complete-bipartite specialist comparison found no previous exact equilibrium-size enumerator, nor the new uniform-equilibrium Lambert-W concentration and fairness constant. Searches of published mathematical records and the accessible prior research ledger found related work on other network games or graph counts but no implication of the enumerator/asymptotic. Absence from search is not uniqueness proof; priority remains conditional on undiscovered specialized results.

value.rationale: It is a natural equilibrium-selection statistic for a network-constrained public-chores game. While an existence theorem and local-improvement criterion were known, the full cycle-length polynomial reveals exactly how many equilibria have a given recurring burden. The uniform-equilibrium limit shows that typical equilibria retain only 63.81% of agents in the recurrent cycle and incur a precise 1.56714 fairness penalty relative to the best equilibrium, distinguishing generic equilibrium behavior from worst-case price of anarchy. This constant and the complete labeled census are not merely renamings or an arbitrary narrow slice.
